title: The full suite runs 21.9-22.3 s at 100 ids on darwin, over its 22 s ceiling at load under 2, so the SP-7n3d4jte review cannot finish
goal: The SP-7n3d4jte review story's done ran tests.py 3 times on 2026-10-12 and a direct --no-reuse run once more: every run passed all 100 tests in 21.90-22.32 s of pytest time and exited 1 on the darwin 22 s ceiling (D-7ngv63af), the last two at a load average under 2, and a clone at 38f1fe80a from before this sprint's code ran 22.5 s, so waiting for a quiet host no longer helps; the slowest tests are the land and sync e2e scenarios (13.4, 12.7, 12.5, 10.8 and 9.3 s). The darwin max_seconds in _tools/tests_ceiling.json follows the operator's recorded answer to this item's gate, with that decision's id in the file, and a full tests.py run on this host exits 0.
repro_reason: a full suite run is the behaviour, but the review story's done already runs it; the repro pins the number the gate decides

gates.question: The suite passes all 100 tests in 21.9-22.3 s of pytest time on darwin (wall up to 23 s), over the 22 s ceiling at load under 2: raise the darwin seconds, or cut the suite's time first?
options: keep darwin at 22 and cut the suite's time (a test-speed story on the land and sync e2e scenarios) before the review can finish
